what: Loading study: tuned 16-rung low-pass birdcage (D 28 cm, L 25 cm, 34 cm closed PEC/copper shield, C 1.828 pF per rung, not retuned) with a centred homogeneous cylindrical phantom (length 20 cm). Palace eigenmode, eighth model, production mesh density (5 / 2.5 / 35 mm, 20 mm in the phantom), order 2. Simulation only.

method.Q_phantom: Palace Q of the k=1 member with lossless coil (phantom loss only)
method.Q_L: Palace Q with phantom + copper (5.8e7 S/m on strips and shield, Conductivity boundary) + capacitor ESR 0.68 ohm (parallel R at f0)
method.Q_U: Q_L of the eps_r = 1, sigma = 0 case on the same mesh
method.B1: quadrature B1+ of the two k=1 members (two eighth runs), normalised to mean |B1+| = 1 uT over the ROI r < 8.4 cm, |z| < 4.17 cm; phantom slice = z = 0 plane inside the phantom
method.E: |E| of the same quadrature field (1 uT mean B1+); SAR-like = sigma |E|^2 / 2 in W/m^3 (no tissue density), at the probes (z = 0 and y = 0 planes, 3D ROI grid) more than 3 mm inside the phantom
